mapper.select: where activity_id=#{activityId} and status='published' and del_flag='0' order by version_no desc limit 1

mapper.update:
update yc_activity_home_version
page_json=#{pageJson}, schema_version=#{schemaVersion}, publish_remark=#{publishRemark}, publish_at=#{publishAt}, publish_mode=#{publishMode}, status=#{status}, update_by=#{updateBy}, remark=#{remark}, update_time=sysdate()
where version_id=#{versionId} and del_flag='0'
